title: Exchange Rates
error.service: The rates service did not answer ({1})
error.answer: The rates service sent an answer the plugin does not understand
settings.target.about: When the command names one currency, like /cur 100 usd. A code such as EUR; RUB if empty.
settings.show_date.about: Adds a line with the date the rate was published.
settings.usage: Type /cur 100 usd rub in any chat: the command is not sent, the result is. Codes (USD, EUR, CNY…), symbols ($ € ₽ ¥ £ ₸ ₴) and names (dollar, euro, yuan…) work. Rates are updated once an hour.
